facts.text: The St. Regis Chicago is situated where the Chicago River meets Lake Michigan.
facts.excerpt: Situated at a premier location where the Chicago River meets Lake Michigan

facts.text: The St. Regis Chicago is in the tallest building in the world designed by a female architect.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Chicago, the tallest building in the world designed by a female architect

facts.text: The tower was designed by Jeanne Gang.
facts.excerpt: this undulating tower by Jeanne Gang—the tallest building in the world by a female architect

facts.text: Tre Dita is designated as the first certified Tuscan restaurant in the United States.
facts.excerpt: Designated as the first certified Tuscan restaurant in the United States

facts.text: Tre Dita is led by Chef Evan Funke and serves handmade Tuscan pasta and dishes prepared on a woodfire grill.
facts.excerpt: Led by award-winning Chef Evan Funke, indulge in handmade Tuscan pasta and signature dishes prepared on a woodfire grill.

facts.text: Tre Dita means three fingers in Italian, a nod to the measurement of bistecca Fiorentina.
facts.excerpt: Tre Dita, Italian for "three fingers", pays homage to the precise measurement of bistecca Fiorentina

facts.text: Miru, on the 11th floor, offers all-day dining and Japanese-inspired dishes with two outdoor terraces, led by Chef Hisanobu Osaka.
facts.excerpt: On the sprawling 11th floor, indulge in all-day dining and Japanese-inspired dishes atop two outdoor terraces at Miru, led by esteemed Chef Hisanobu Osaka.

facts.text: Miru means view in Japanese.
facts.excerpt: Miru (meaning “view” in Japanese)

facts.text: The hotel's Bloody Mary, The 1871, is a tribute to the Great Chicago Fire and uses a local rye whiskey.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in The 1871 at The St. Regis Chicago, a tribute to the Great Chicago Fire, which incorporates a local Rye Whiskey.

facts.text: The Evening Ritual of champagne sabrage takes place daily at sunset.
facts.excerpt: the art of champagne sabrage is a glittering ceremony which takes place daily at sunset

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa was awarded the Forbes Travel Guide 5-Star Spa distinction.
facts.excerpt: Awarded the Forbes Travel Guide 5-Star Spa distinction

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa has a Celebration Bar and an Iridium Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Sip the finest champagne at the Celebration Bar then transcend and connect in the Iridium Lounge

facts.text: The spa's Celebration Suite is a gathering space where couples, families and friends can have treatments together.
facts.excerpt: The Celebration Suite offers a bespoke gathering space for couples, families, and friends to enjoy treatment time together.

facts.text: The fitness facility has a heated indoor swimming pool, an outdoor pool sundeck and a yoga studio.
facts.excerpt: features a fitness facility with a heated indoor swimming pool, outdoor pool sundeck, yoga studio

facts.text: The fitness facility has two private fitness rooms.
facts.excerpt: yoga studio, and two private fitness rooms

facts.text: The Athletic Club has three private rooms.
facts.excerpt: State-of-the-art fitness equipment, three private rooms

facts.text: The Athletic Club has a dedicated Pilates studio.
facts.excerpt: a dedicated Pilates studio, and a robust schedule of classes

facts.text: The hotel's arrival esplanade connects openly with Lakeshore East Park, a 6-acre development with green space and ornamental water gardens.
facts.excerpt: openly connects its bustling arrival esplanade with Lakeshore East Park, an award-winning 6-acre development with vast green space, ornamental water gardens

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Take in the sights of the Windy City through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Rooms have private marble bathrooms with rainfall showers.
facts.excerpt: unwind in your private marble bathroom with rainfall showers and luxurious bath amenities

facts.text: Every room comes with one of four types of soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: comes with one of four types of soaking tubs, all deliciously inviting

facts.text: Rooms have Frette linens and down comforters.
facts.excerpt: Frette linens and down comforters in our luxury accommodation in Chicago

facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available exclusively for suite accommodations, including complimentary packing and unpacking.
facts.excerpt: Accessible exclusively for suite accommodations, from complimentary packing & unpacking services to garment pressings to arranging bespoke experiences

facts.text: The Caroline Astor Suite is inspired by Caroline Astor, the Gilded Age doyenne and mother of John Jacob Astor IV.
facts.excerpt: is inspired by John’s mother, the tirelessly inventive Gilded Age doyenne, Caroline Astor

facts.text: Designers Gensler and KTGY Simeone Deary Design drew inspiration from the buildings that followed the Chicago Fire of 1871.
facts.excerpt: Gensler and KTGY Simeone Deary Design looked to the style of building that came after the Chicago Fire of 1871 for inspiration

facts.text: The 101-story tower has St. Regis condominiums above the 11-story hotel.
facts.excerpt: the 101-story tower (above the 11-story hotel sits 393 St. Regis condominiums)

facts.text: The Library Lounge on the 11th floor is always open to the public.
facts.excerpt: head to the 11th floor Drawing Room to work or take meetings in the Library Lounge that’s always open to the public

facts.text: An all-electric Rivian house car offers guests complimentary chauffeur-driven rides within a two-mile radius.
facts.excerpt: the property features an all-electric Rivian as its complimentary house car, offering guests eco-conscious, chauffeur-driven transportation within a two-mile radius of the property

facts.text: The hotel does not have electric vehicle charging stations.
facts.excerpt: No, The St. Regis Chicago does not have electric vehicle charging stations.

facts.text: There are EV charging spots in the on-site garage.
facts.excerpt: There are EV charging spots in the on-site garage

facts.text: The Family Traditions program offers activities and experiences tailored to younger guests and their families.
facts.excerpt: Family Traditions at The St. Regis Chicago offers engaging activities and thoughtful experiences tailored to younger guests and their families.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange private tours of the Field Museum and the Art Institute of Chicago with advance notice.
facts.excerpt: To reserve a Private Tour of the Field Museum (14 day advance notice required) or the Art Institute of Chicago (72 hour advance notice required), connect with our Concierge team

facts.text: The entrance is on Upper Wacker Drive, not Lower Wacker.
facts.excerpt: Our entrance is on Upper Wacker Drive. If GPS sends you underground, stay on Upper Wacker, do not go to Lower Wacker.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with a maximum of two per room and a non-refundable fee per stay.
facts.excerpt: 2 Pet Maximum per room with 150USD Non-Refundable Fee per room per stay

facts.text: Lakeshore East, between the hotel and Lake Michigan, is a quiet residential area.
facts.excerpt: the space between its circular driveway and Lake Michigan is a very posh residential area called Lakeshore East. It’s quiet

facts.text: Millennium Park and the Art Institute of Chicago are a few blocks away.
facts.excerpt: Millennium Park and the Art Institute of Chicago are a few blocks away

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa is Chicago's only Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star spa.
facts.excerpt: Discover Chicago's Only Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Spa

facts.text: The property is LEED Commercial Interiors certified.
facts.excerpt: LEED: Commercial Interiors Certified
